messages:
sandeep: FWIW customers hitting double provisional charges on reconnect path. Repro shows prefetch toolcall credited as provisional, then reconnect does a confirmed toolcall and ledger ends up with both. Seems tied to session metadata TTL getting dropped during route failover.
julia: Can you paste the minimal repro and headers?
sandeep: Steps: 1) client opens streaming chat 2) runtime issues background prefetch/toolcall (prefetch=true) 3) primary route fails -> router falls back 4) reconnect on secondary resumes and issues the same toolcall but with new session id. Ledger shows provisional + confirmed = double bill.
chris: Do we preserve any identifier across the two paths? session id changes?
sandeep: session id is rewritten by the fallback proxy. We do send `x-session-meta-ttl: 5s` on initial, but the fallback clears it. There's no stable fingerprint propagated.
laura: So dedupe currently relies on session id equality. If session id flips we lose idempotency.
julia: Options: (a) make client pass idempotency-key for toolcalls (breaking) (b) router emits stable fingerprint header computed from session metadata (server-side) (c) ledger computes a prefix fingerprint from tokens at ingest. Thoughts?
chris: (b) feels right since we avoid client changes. Router already touches headers; adding a `x-session-fingerprint` = hash(session_meta + model + route) seems cheap. But it touches many components (router, runtime, ledger).
sandeep: Telemetry/UI change required: Console token view groups by session id today. We need to surface fingerprint to make provisional rows explainable.
laura: Cardinality risk: adding fingerprint as a first-class dimension could blow up dashboards. We should only surface fingerprints on provisional/failed-fallback rows or keep it opt-in.
julia: Rollout UX: gate via console flag per-customer, and enable only for Dedicated/customers first. Add a canary that compares charge deltas.
ops-bot: deploybot: note that router change requires a migration plan: add fingerprint column to ledger (nullable) and backfill? suggested safe deploy: write-only field for 2 weeks then backfill offline. Might need a brief index build.
billing-bot: Billing constraints: any attribution change must keep existing invoices stable for GA customers. If we switch dedupe heuristics, how do we avoid crediting back mid-billing-cycle?
sandeep: Proposal: 1) implement router fingerprint (stable hash of session_meta JSON canonicalized + model + toolcall name), populate `fingerprint` on provisional entries only 2) make ledger dedupe logic accept fingerprint match when session_id mismatch 3) expose fingerprint in console for provisional rows (7d retention) 4) migrate to enable-by-default after 30d canary.
chris: Implementation notes: hashing cost ~200ns/request in Rust router. Storage: add `fingerprint` varchar(64) nullable on ledger. Dedup step: match on (session_id OR fingerprint) + toolcall_signature + request_prefix.
laura: Dashboard: instrument a new telemetry metric `token.duplicate_detected_by_fingerprint` and sample traces. Avoid adding fingerprint as a join key in high-cardinality aggregation.
julia: I'll draft an RFC capturing API header `x-session-fp`, router impl, ledger schema, console toggle, and canary plan. Include a rollback plan (revert router header, no schema drop).
sandeep: I'll paste repro gist and a sample ksql query for the anomaly. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-session-fp. Query: `select session_id, fingerprint, sum(tokens) from ledger where provisional=true group by 1,2`
op-bot: deploybot: marking this as medium-risk. Need db index during low traffic window.
billing-bot: Can we run a dry-run mode that only emits fingerprint but doesn't change dedupe? Then compare provisional vs confirmed spikes before enabling dedupe.
chris: good call. We'll add `dedupe_enabled=false` default for 2 weeks, collect metrics, then flip.
laura: +1. Also add unit tests for route-failover path and an integration test that runs on nightly against staging cluster.
julia: ack. I'll file RFC and CIR (console-integration request). sandeep, please attach the minimal log snippet here.
sandeep: done, pushed logs and a tiny docker repro to the gist. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
